title: Ms
incidentLocation: Royal Infirmary of Edinburgh, Accident & Emergency department
incidentSummary: I fell on my outstretched hand. A&E X-rayed my wrist and told me it was a sprain. The pain did not go away. Weeks later a scaphoid fracture was found. It has not healed, I now need surgery, and I have missed my second-year exams and shifts at my part-time job.

events.what: Fell on outstretched hand and attended A&E at the Royal Infirmary. X-rayed, told it was a sprain, sent home.
Pain continued. My GP sent me back and a second X-ray showed a scaphoid fracture.
The fracture has not healed and I now need surgery.
Missed my second-year exams and had to stop shifts at my part-time job because I cannot use my wrist.

desiredOutcome: An explanation of what went wrong, treatment or support to put things right and compensation for what happened.
